data.narrative:
Freenome is a publicly traded biotech and health company currently valued at $1.1B, having raised $1.3B+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set of 11 peers across the Biotech & Health sector—3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private firms spanning Series C through public stages, including Abridge ($5.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), and Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B).

A peer-median method was applied to the six same-sector comparables closest in valuation tier. This cohort spans a range from $539M to $5.3B, with a median valuation of $2.4B. This represents the only applicable triangulation method; a public-comp anchoring approach using the sector's 6.6x price-to-sales median could not be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures for the target. Public-comp P/S multiples are therefore not actionable here.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.0B (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $2.4B—implying 18% to 145% upside from the current $1.1B valuation. The wide peer range ($539M–$5.3B) and reliance on a single applicable method introduce material uncertainty. Key risk factors include stage heterogeneity among comparables and the absence of revenue-normalized metrics to calibrate relative positioning within the cohort.
